state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the mileage rate for a business trip in a private electric car today? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the daily meal allowance for a standard travel day today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q3: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request with dependent children today? (answer in EUR)
- Q4: What monthly mobile allowance applied to a regular employee using a private phone on 2026-01-15? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q5: What is the purchase approval threshold for a regular department's purchase from a supplier with a framework contract today? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the nightly lodging limit for a contractor on a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: nightly lodging limit a contractor on a business trip to Geneva
state.step_intent: Find the nightly lodging limit that applies to: What is the nightly lodging limit for a contractor on a business trip to Geneva today?

passages.source: HB-40 §2 | Memo: nightly lodging limit exceptions — Exception for business trips to Zurich, Geneva or Oslo | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-06-01
passages.text: For business trips to Zurich, Geneva or Oslo, the nightly lodging limit is 280 EUR per night instead of the standard amount. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted.

passages.source: HB-04 §2 | Travel policy: lodging — Standard nightly lodging limit | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-14
passages.text: The nightly lodging limit for business travel is 180 EUR per night, including taxes and city fees. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims.

passages.source: HB-14 §2 | Travel policy: lodging — Standard nightly lodging limit | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-06-01 to the day before 2026-06-01 · superseded by: HB-04
passages.text: The nightly lodging limit for business travel was 170 EUR per night, including taxes and city fees. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims.

passages.source: HB-06 §6 | Policy FAQ — Current nightly lodging limit | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard nightly lodging limit? A: 180 EUR per night, as set in HB-04 §2 (effective 2026-06-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-40.

passages.source: HB-40 §1 | Memo: nightly lodging limit exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-06-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the nightly lodging limit in HB-04. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment.
